purpose: Second expanded public source layer focused on medicinal heterocycles, multicomponent reaction scaffolds, click/bioorthogonal motifs, organoboron motifs, and compliance-gated diazepine-like privileged scaffolds.

promotion_requirements: explicit precursor structures before template or proposal promotion
safety, controlled-substance, and biosecurity review where relevant
safety_scope: records intentionally avoid quantities, operational procedures, and synthesis conditions
regulated sedative, toxic natural-product, and bioactive probe families are high-level route priors only

families.name: 1,2,3-triazoles, click linkers, and bioorthogonal cycloadditions
families.strategic_principle: Disconnect triazole and bioorthogonal ligation products to azide/alkyne or tetrazine/dienophile partners. Treat metal compatibility, live-system compatibility, and labeling kinetics as route metadata rather than generic heterocycle formation.

families.name: Benzimidazoles, benzoxazoles, and benzothiazoles
families.strategic_principle: Map fused azole rings to ortho-difunctionalized anilines plus carbonyl, carboxylic-acid derivative, nitrile, or related one-carbon/two-carbon partners. Track which heteroatom pair controls ring identity.

families.name: Pyrazoles, isoxazoles, and related five-membered azoles
families.strategic_principle: Disconnect pyrazoles/isoxazoles to beta-dicarbonyl or dipolar cycloaddition precursors. Regioisomer control is the main strategic issue for unsymmetrical substrates.

families.name: Benzofuran and medicinal indole annulations
families.strategic_principle: Expose benzofuran/indole cores as annulation problems: phenol/alkyne or salicylaldehyde logic for benzofurans, and phenylhydrazone or o-haloaniline/alkyne logic for indoles. Avoid late same-core decoration as a substitute for ring construction.

families.name: Quinazolines, quinazolinones, and 4-anilinoquinazoline kinase-like scaffolds
families.strategic_principle: Build the quinazoline/quinazolinone ring from anthranilic-acid, anthranilamide, o-aminobenzamide, or related ortho-amino aryl-carbonyl precursors, then treat C4 anilino/SNAr diversification as late scaffold decoration.

families.name: Ugi, Passerini, Strecker, and amino-acid multicomponent scaffolds
families.strategic_principle: Recognize alpha-acylamino amides, alpha-acyloxy amides, and aminonitrile/amino-acid motifs as multicomponent-reaction products. Use component-level retrosynthesis but gate hazardous nucleophiles, isocyanides, and stereochemical control.

families.name: Hantzsch dihydropyridines and Biginelli dihydropyrimidinones
families.strategic_principle: Disconnect Hantzsch/Biginelli heterocycles to aldehyde, beta-ketoester, ammonia/amine, and urea/thiourea component sets. Substitution symmetry and oxidation state determine whether the MCR is strategic or only a late analogue-making shortcut.

families.name: Isoindolinones, phthalimides, and imide medicinal scaffolds
families.strategic_principle: Map imide and isoindolinone cores to phthalic anhydride/phthalimide anchors, o-acyl benzamide precursors, or intramolecular C-N/C-C annulation precursors. Track imide substitution and stereochemical liabilities explicitly.

families.name: Oxindoles, isatins, and spirooxindole natural-product-like scaffolds
families.strategic_principle: Use isatin/oxindole as a strategic anchor for C3-functionalization, spirocyclization, Mannich, and 1,3-dipolar cycloaddition routes. Spirocenter stereochemistry and dipolarophile choice are route-defining.

families.name: Boronic acids, boronates, benzoxaboroles, and organoboron medicinal motifs
families.strategic_principle: Separate organoboron motif installation from downstream cross-coupling or biological warhead use. Choose between carrying a protected boronate, installing boron late, or using boron as a coupling handle, while tracking protodeboronation and purification risk.

families.name: Diazepine and benzodiazepine-like privileged scaffolds
families.strategic_principle: Compliance-gated high-level prior only: map diazepine-like rings to ortho-amino aryl carbonyl/amidide tethers or PBD biosynthetic/synthetic anchors, then treat ring closure and N-substitution as reviewed medicinal-chemistry transformations.

families.name: Benzofused lactams, lactones, and coumarin-adjacent oxygen/nitrogen heterocycles
families.strategic_principle: Disconnect benzofused lactones/lactams to ortho-hydroxy or ortho-amino aryl acid/aldehyde precursors. Ring closure order and oxidation state should be explicit, especially when the target resembles a protected phenol or phthalimide analogue.

anchors.name: Carbonyl, amine, acid, isocyanide, and cyanide-equivalent component set
Aldehyde, beta-ketoester, nitrogen donor, and urea component set
Phthalic anhydride/phthalimide or o-acyl benzamide precursor
Boronic acid/boronate motif or coupling handle
Ortho-amino aryl carbonyl or PBD tether precursor
Ortho-hydroxy/ortho-amino aryl acid or aldehyde lactone/lactam precursor

disconnections.name: 1,2,3-triazole azide-alkyne click disconnection

break_bonds: triazole C-N/C-C bonds corresponding to azide and alkyne partners
forward_logic: prepare azide-bearing and alkyne-bearing fragments separately
choose CuAAC or strain-promoted cycloaddition depending on biological and metal constraints
track triazole regioisomer and copper compatibility
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward fragment convergence through a triazole only when azide/alkyne placement and compatibility are explicit.

risks: linker may be SAR decoration rather than core simplification

evidence.citation: 1,2,3-triazole medicinal chemistry overview describes CuAAC and triazole hybrids.
Triazole synthesis review summarizes Cu-catalyzed azide-alkyne cycloaddition and other methods.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for true fragment convergence with compatibility metadata

break_bonds: bonds formed by inverse-electron-demand Diels-Alder ligation
forward_logic: separate tetrazine and strained dienophile partners
select TCO, norbornene, strained alkyne, or related handle based on kinetics and stability
for imaging, keep isotope and biological half-life constraints separate from synthesis
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Classify as bioorthogonal ligation strategy; do not treat as ordinary Diels-Alder ring construction without context.

evidence.citation: Bioorthogonal chemistry primer discusses tetrazine/TCO IEDDA chemistry and applications.
Tetrazine bioorthogonal chemistry review summarizes in vivo imaging uses.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate when ligation handles and biological context are explicit

disconnections.name: Benzimidazole to o-phenylenediamine plus carbonyl/acid derivative

break_bonds: C-N bonds formed during benzimidazole cyclocondensation
forward_logic: prepare o-phenylenediamine with target aryl substitution pattern
condense with aldehyde, nitrile, carboxylic acid derivative, or one-carbon equivalent
oxidize or dehydrate to aromatic benzimidazole as needed
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward o-diamine/carbonyl split with correct ring substitution; flag arbitrary N-alkyl edits as late decoration.

evidence.citation: Benzimidazole synthesis review categorizes routes from o-phenylenediamine and related partners.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for correct o-diamine/carbonyl mapping

target_features: ortho amino phenol or thiophenol retron

break_bonds: azole C-N and C-O or C-S bonds
forward_logic: prepare o-aminophenol or o-aminothiophenol precursor
condense with aldehyde, carboxylic acid derivative, nitrile, or related carbon source
choose oxidative or dehydrative closure depending on oxidation state
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use the heteroatom identity to select benzoxazole versus benzothiazole precursor; keep oxidation/dehydration risk tags.

evidence.citation: Benzothiazole review covers condensation of o-aminothiophenols with carboxylic acids and derivatives.
Benzoxazole synthesis review summarizes routes from 2-aminophenol precursors.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for correct ortho-aminophenol/aminothiophenol mapping

disconnections.name: Pyrazole to hydrazine plus beta-dicarbonyl precursor

break_bonds: pyrazole C-N bonds formed by hydrazine condensation
forward_logic: prepare beta-dicarbonyl or equivalent enone/nitrile precursor
condense with hydrazine or substituted hydrazine
map regioisomers for unsymmetrical carbonyl partners
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Require regioisomer annotation for unsymmetrical pyrazoles and N-substituent order.

evidence.citation: Pyrazole synthesis review describes hydrazine condensation with beta-diketones as a key method.
Pyrazole anti-angiogenesis overview notes beta-diketone/hydrazine condensation as common backbone construction.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for beta-dicarbonyl/hydrazine split with regioisomer tracking

disconnections.name: Isoxazole to hydroxylamine/beta-dicarbonyl or nitrile-oxide cycloaddition precursor

break_bonds: isoxazole C-N/C-O bonds formed by condensation or 1,3-dipolar cycloaddition
forward_logic: choose hydroxylamine plus beta-dicarbonyl equivalent or nitrile oxide plus alkyne/alkene
track regioselectivity for unsymmetrical dipolarophiles
distinguish isoxazole from isoxazoline oxidation state
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Generate isoxazole strategies only with regioselectivity and oxidation-state tags.

evidence.citation: Isoxazole chemistry review highlights cycloadditions, green approaches, and regioselective functionalization.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for mapped hydroxylamine or nitrile-oxide route

disconnections.name: Benzofuran phenol/alkyne or carbonyl annulation disconnection

break_bonds: benzofuran C-O/C-C bonds formed during annulation
forward_logic: map to o-alkynyl phenol, salicylaldehyde, phenoxy carbonyl, or related ortho-functionalized precursor
choose cycloisomerization, oxidative annulation, or condensation based on substitution pattern
handle phenol protection and aryl substitution before ring closure
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward ring-opening to a credible ortho-phenol precursor; flag routes that only decorate an intact benzofuran.

evidence.citation: Benzofuran synthesis review summarizes catalytic strategies and medicinal relevance.
Benzofuran natural product review summarizes sources, bioactivity, and common chemical synthesis approaches.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for credible ortho-phenol annulation precursor

disconnections.name: Medicinal indole Fischer or Larock annulation disconnection

break_bonds: indole C-N/C-C bonds formed by Fischer rearrangement or Larock annulation
forward_logic: map Fischer routes to arylhydrazine plus aldehyde/ketone-derived hydrazone
map Larock routes to o-haloaniline plus alkyne
choose annulation route based on substitution pattern and functional group tolerance
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use for medicinal indole core construction; for complex indole alkaloids prefer the separate biosynthetic/Pictet-Spengler family.

evidence.citation: Medicinal indole overview lists Fischer, Bischler-Mohlau, Hemetsberger, and related indole syntheses.
Larock-type annulation article describes indole construction from o-haloaniline/alkyne partners.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate when annulation mode matches substitution pattern

break_bonds: quinazoline pyrimidine ring bonds formed from ortho-amino aryl carbonyl precursor
forward_logic: prepare anthranilic acid, anthranilamide, o-aminobenzamide, or related precursor
build quinazolinone/quinazoline core by cyclocondensation or transition-metal-catalyzed route
convert core oxidation/halogenation state only after ring identity is set
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward core annulation before late kinase-hinge substituent decoration.

evidence.citation: Quinazoline synthesis review covers transition-metal-catalyzed and classical routes.
Quinazoline/quinazolinone chemical characteristics review summarizes synthetic methods and medicinal scaffolds.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for anthranilic-core annulation with oxidation-state tracking

disconnections.name: 4-Anilinoquinazoline late C4 substitution disconnection

break_bonds: C4 quinazoline-N aniline bond
forward_logic: prepare activated 4-halo/4-leaving-group quinazoline core
install aniline or heteroarylamine substituent late
track competing C2/C4 substitution and solubility/SAR constraints
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Treat as late diversification after core annulation; do not score as route-solving if core remains product-like.

risks: medicinal SAR may constrain substitution order

evidence.citation: Quinazoline derivatives review discusses synthesis and broad biological activities including kinase-related scaffolds.
Chemical insights review summarizes decorated quinazoline frameworks for agrochemical and pharmaceutical uses.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: low_to_moderate and only after core route exists

disconnections.name: Ugi/Passerini isocyanide multicomponent disconnection

break_bonds: bonds connecting carbonyl, amine, acid, and isocyanide components
forward_logic: map product substituents to aldehyde/ketone, amine, carboxylic acid, and isocyanide components
for Passerini products, map carbonyl, acid, and isocyanide components
use post-MCR cyclization only when the downstream ring closure is explicit
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward component-level convergence but require isocyanide availability and stereochemical review.

risks: MCR product may be analogue-generation rather than strategic simplification

evidence.citation: Multicomponent reactions for API synthesis review covers Ugi and Passerini routes.
Post-Ugi cyclization review covers Ugi adducts as heterocycle precursors.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for clear component mapping and post-MCR plan

break_bonds: C-C/C-N bonds formed by imine addition in amino-acid MCR
forward_logic: map alpha substituent to aldehyde or ketone component
choose Strecker-like aminonitrile route or Petasis-like boronic acid route based on chirality and safety
track hydrolysis/protection and enantiocontrol separately
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Hazard-gate cyanide-equivalent routes and require stereochemical plan for non-racemic targets.

evidence.citation: Petasis versus Strecker review compares amino-acid synthesis strategies and opportunities.
Strecker-derived methodology article describes aminonitrile library synthesis in medicinal chemistry.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate when chirality and hazard review are explicit

break_bonds: dihydropyridine ring bonds formed by Hantzsch condensation
forward_logic: map C4 substituent to aldehyde component
map ester/ketone substituents to beta-ketoester components
choose ammonia or amine nitrogen donor and track oxidation to pyridine when relevant
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward Hantzsch MCR only when component symmetry and oxidation state match the target.

evidence.citation: Dihydropyridine synthesis review describes Hantzsch MCR and medicinal relevance.
MCR API review summarizes Hantzsch dihydropyridine synthesis.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for clean component mapping

break_bonds: dihydropyrimidinone ring bonds formed by Biginelli condensation
forward_logic: map aryl/alkyl substituent to aldehyde component
map ester/ketone portion to beta-ketoester or dicarbonyl component
choose urea or thiourea component and track asymmetric induction if required
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use for Biginelli adducts and DHPM scaffolds; require stereochemical tags for asymmetric targets.

evidence.citation: Asymmetric Biginelli review summarizes DHPM and DHPMT formation strategies.
Biginelli adduct mini-review discusses pharmacological DHPM examples.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for correct aldehyde/beta-ketoester/urea mapping

disconnections.name: Phthalimide to phthalic anhydride/imide N-functionalization precursor

break_bonds: imide N-substituent bond
imide C-N bonds to phthalic anhydride precursor
forward_logic: build phthalimide core from phthalic anhydride or related phthalate precursor
install N-substituent or use NH-phthalimide as masked amine/functional handle
track imide hydrolysis and stereochemical liabilities for chiral substituents
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward phthalic anhydride/imide anchor exposure; flag late N-functionalization as decoration if core is unchanged.

evidence.citation: Phthalimide synthesis and functionalization review covers recent phthalimide chemistry.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for core-building or N-functionalization with risk tags

disconnections.name: Isoindolinone to o-acyl benzamide or C-H annulation precursor

break_bonds: lactam C-N bond
benzylic C-C or C-N bond formed by annulation
forward_logic: map to o-acyl benzamide, imine, or C-H annulation precursor
choose reductive cyclization, metal-catalyzed C-C formation, or imide reduction route
track ring oxidation state separately from N-substitution
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use when isoindolinone core is strategically opened; late N-substituent edits alone are weak evidence.

evidence.citation: Isoindolinone synthesis review covers one-pot transition-metal-catalyzed C-C bond forming reactions.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for credible o-acyl benzamide or annulation mapping

target_features: isatin or C3 carbonyl precursor possible

break_bonds: C3 substituent bond on oxindole/isatin-derived center
forward_logic: use isatin or oxindole as core anchor
install C3 substituent by addition, Mannich, aldol, alkylation, or cycloaddition logic
track stereochemistry and tautomer/oxidation state
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward explicit isatin/oxindole anchor and C3 stereochemical plan.

evidence.citation: Isatin derivatives review describes isatin as a versatile precursor for oxindole-containing derivatives.
Isatin anticancer review discusses oxindole and spirooxindole biological relevance.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit C3 functionalization route

break_bonds: two sigma bonds formed by 1,3-dipolar cycloaddition at oxindole C3
forward_logic: generate azomethine ylide from isatin and amino-acid/imine precursor
select alkene/alkyne dipolarophile matching ring and substituent pattern
track regioselectivity and spirocenter stereochemistry
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use only when spiro ring atoms can be mapped to dipole and dipolarophile components.

evidence.citation: Isatin review covers spirooxindole synthesis by multicomponent and 1,3-dipolar cycloaddition routes.
Dipolarophile-controlled spirooxindole article demonstrates divergent 1,3-dipolar cycloaddition access.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate when component mapping and stereochemistry are explicit

disconnections.name: Organoboron motif installation and protection disconnection

break_bonds: C-B bond or benzoxaborole C-O/B-O ring closure
forward_logic: choose borylation, lithiation/borylation, Miyaura borylation, or protected-boron building block route
select boronate protection such as pinacol, MIDA, or other stabilizing form when needed
separate pharmacophore boron from cross-coupling handle boron
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Track whether boron survives to target or is used as a coupling handle; flag protodeboronation/purification risk.

risks: boron pharmacophore may not tolerate downstream chemistry

evidence.citation: Boronic acids medicinal chemistry review covers synthesis and biological applications.
Boron chemicals in drug discovery review covers boronic acids, benzoxaboroles, and boron-containing candidates.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit boron role and stability plan

break_bonds: reversible B-O or iminoboronate linkage
forward_logic: separate stable covalent scaffold from reversible boronic-acid recognition partner
choose boronic acid, benzoxaborole, or dynamic click pair based on pH and target context
do not mark reversible recognition complex as ordinary isolated product without evidence
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use as a recognition/conjugation prior; distinguish reversible complexes from isolable synthetic intermediates.

evidence.citation: Boronic-acid dynamic click chemistry review covers iminoboronate and salicylhydroxamate-boronate systems.
Boronic-acid molecular recognition review covers chemical biology applications.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: low_to_moderate and only with reversible-binding context

disconnections.name: Diazepine ring closure to ortho-amino aryl carbonyl tether

break_bonds: diazepine C-N or amide ring-closing bond
forward_logic: map ring to an ortho-amino aryl carbonyl or anthranilamide-like tether precursor
treat N-substitution and annelation as late medicinal-chemistry edits after core route exists
require controlled-substance and toxicology review before proposal generation
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Compliance-gated high-level route critique only; do not emit operational routes for controlled sedative analogues.

evidence.citation: IntechOpen chapter reviews 1,4-benzodiazepine description, analysis, and organic synthesis at high level.
Open-access benzodiazepine synthesis article describes modern 1,4-benzodiazepine skeleton construction strategies.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: low and compliance-gated

break_bonds: PBD diazepine ring-closing bonds
linker bond for conjugates when present
forward_logic: recognize PBD core as toxic natural-product-like scaffold requiring review
separate PBD core assembly from linker/conjugate installation
use biosynthetic or reviewed synthetic anchor only for critique, not automatic proposal
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Compliance- and toxicology-gated; prioritize route critique and evidence tagging over generation.

evidence.citation: Pyrrolobenzodiazepine synthesis update reviews PBD synthetic approaches.
PBD biosynthesis/synthesis review covers biological activities and biosynthetic context.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: low and compliance-gated

break_bonds: lactone C-O bond
lactam C-N bond
benzylic C-O bond when phthalide oxidation state is involved
forward_logic: map to ortho-hydroxy or ortho-amino aryl acid/aldehyde precursor
choose lactonization/lactamization or oxidation-state adjustment before ring closure
separate phenol/amine protection from core-forming ring closure
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward ortho-functionalized aryl-acid precursor exposure and oxidation-state tracking.

evidence.citation: Phthalimide and related imide review covers phthalic-anhydride-derived heterocycles and functionalization.
Isatin derivative review includes benzofused heterocycle and lactam/lactone transformations in medicinal contexts.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for ortho-functionalized precursor mapping

source_notes.summary: The v3 expansion adds common medicinal heterocycle and multicomponent-reaction source families that bridge template-level retrosynthesis and strategic route critique.

Diazepine/PBD, cyanide-equivalent Strecker, azide, hydrazine, and bioorthogonal labeling records are advisory only. They require project-level safety, legal, and compliance review before any proposal-source promotion.
